app.name: SAPatcher
app.slogan: A utility that changes the course of the game on modern PCs in the old GTA SA
app.description: Optimization and preparation of classic GTA SA and multiplayer modifications (CRMP, SAMP) for running on modern hardware by translating DirectX 9 to Vulkan via DXVK.

diagnostics.title: System Hardware Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Evaluation of hardware and software components readiness for DirectX 9 to Vulkan translation

os.card_subtitle: Windows kernel and graphics subsystem configuration
os.note: Windows subsystem is optimized for Vulkan hardware descriptors and low frame latencies.

gpu.card_subtitle: Hardware acceleration and Vulkan API extension support
gpu.verdict_text: Your graphics card fully supports DXVK 3.1.1 for GTA SA translation.
gpu.verdict_desc: Full hardware pipeline compilation into GPU memory is available with zero first-launch stutters.

cpu.card_subtitle: Multithreaded overhead and vector instruction set support
cpu.overhead_title: CPU Power Reserve for Vulkan Rendering
cpu.overhead_desc: DXVK translation relieves the single-threaded D3D9 driver, distributing draw calls across all logical CPU cores.

display.card_subtitle: Screen specifications, refresh rates, and HDR capabilities
display.note: DXVK Vulkan translation allows GTA SA to run smoothly at high refresh rates (144-200 Hz) with synchronized physics.

patching.crmp_desc: DXVK translation integration for the CRMP client. Includes custom UI fixes, font crash prevention, and smooth frame rate synchronization.
patching.samp_desc: Injection of optimized d3d9.dll and dxvk.conf libraries into the SA-MP directory with 2K/4K resolution support and rock-solid 60-144 FPS.
patching.projects_desc: Universal patcher for Radmir, Province, Amazing, Arizona launchers with automatic bypass of file integrity check overwrites.

projects.panel_subtitle: Universal profiler and DXVK / 4GB RAM Patch injector for custom CRMP and SAMP launchers
projects.catalog_title: SUPPORTED PROJECTS CATALOG (XBOX ONE DASHBOARD TILES)
projects.motion_tile_desc: Custom engine on GTA SA with HD models and high resolution textures.

motion.title: Motion Project — Vulkan & 4GB LAA Studio
motion.subtitle: Automatic Motion Launcher path detection, DXVK translator injection, and 4GB RAM address space expansion
motion.game_path_title: Motion Project Game Directory (GTA San Andreas)
motion.dxvk311_desc: Maximum FPS, parallel shader compilation, and optimized for modern NVIDIA RTX/GTX GPUs.
motion.dxvk30_desc: Proven branch with low VRAM usage and Extended Dynamic State support.
motion.dxvk23_desc: High stability for custom ENB post-shaders, SkyGFX, and legacy ASI plugins.
motion.dxvk1103_desc: Classic version providing maximum legacy compatibility for older GPUs.
motion.laa_hint: Eliminates crashes due to 2GB virtual memory exhaustion
motion.laa_checkbox_title: Activate 4GB RAM Patch (Large Address Aware / LAA Flag)
motion.laa_checkbox_desc: By default, the 32-bit GTA SA engine is limited to 2GB of virtual memory. This patch sets the IMAGE_FILE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE flag, expanding available memory to 4GB and completely eliminating 'Warning: Low memory' crashes and freezes when loading custom HD vehicles and skins in Motion Project.
motion.fps_limit_desc: Eliminates screen tearing, frametime spikes, and reduces GPU workload
motion.hud_scale_hint: Value 0.75 keeps the overlay compact without obscuring in-game chat
motion.tweak_seamless_desc: Seamless window switching and Alt-Tab without D3D9 device loss or font corruptions.
motion.tweak_tearfree_desc: Tear-free presentation and minimal frame queue latency (zero mouse input lag).
motion.tweak_vsync_desc: Complete disablement of vertical synchronization at Direct3D 9 and Vulkan levels.
motion.btn_install_disabled_hint: Unpack and patch launcher first before installing DXVK
motion.game_guard_title: Game Folder Protection, DXVK Weights & Fingerprint
